coordinate_system: author start is 0-based (verified author_start0 == GenBank start-1 on mapped proteins)
limitations: Mapping uses author coordinates (0-based starts) to disambiguate repeated protein_id copies; no re-annotation or row-number label reuse.
Unmatched author proteins are enumerated, not filled by nearest-position or name matching.
Operons with any unmapped member are excluded from local-input evaluation.
